The minimum late filing penalty is $25 [KRS. 67- 790(1)] . Late Paying Interest: Interest is computed at one percent (1%) penalty per month or a fraction of a month (twelve percent 12% per annum) from the original due date until the date of payment [KRS67.770] . Types of Payment Payment can be made by check, cashier’s check, money order. We also accept credit card and electronic check payments. Please see our website for further details (www.spencercountyky.gov).
